Module org.slb4j
Package org.slb4j.support.formatter

Class AbstractTimeStampFormatter

java.lang.Object
org.slb4j.support.formatter.AbstractTimeStampFormatter
All Implemented Interfaces:
TimeStampFormatter
Direct Known Subclasses:
ISO8601TimeStampFormatter, PatternTimeStampFormatter, TimeOnlyTimeStampFormatter
public abstract sealed class AbstractTimeStampFormatter extends Object implements TimeStampFormatter permits ISO8601TimeStampFormatter, PatternTimeStampFormatter, TimeOnlyTimeStampFormatter
Base class for high-performance timestamp formatters.

  • Method Details

    • appendTo

      public final void appendTo(long timestamp, Appendable app) throws IOException
      Appends a formatted representation of the given timestamp to the provided Appendable. The timestamp is expected to be in epoch milliseconds, and it is formatted based on the internal configuration of the implementing formatter.
      Specified by:
      appendTo in interface TimeStampFormatter
      Parameters:
      timestamp - the epoch timestamp in milliseconds to be formatted and appended.
      app - the Appendable to which the formatted timestamp will be written.
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs while appending to the Appendable.

    • appendTo

      protected abstract void appendTo(Appendable app, int y, int m, int d, int hour, int minute, int second, int millis, int offsetSeconds) throws IOException
      Formats the timestamp components into the given Appendable.
      Parameters:
      app - the appendable to write to
      y - the year
      m - the month (1-12)
      d - the day of month (1-31)
      hour - the hour (0-23)
      minute - the minute (0-59)
      second - the second (0-59)
      millis - the milliseconds (0-999)
      offsetSeconds - the timezone offset in seconds
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs

    • toString

      public String toString(long timestamp)
      Converts the given timestamp to its corresponding string representation. The method formats the timestamp using a builder-like approach, relying on internally configured components such as pre-defined formatting rules and time zone or offset settings.

      This method is intended for debugging purposes only (it is not garbage-free, i.e., when used for logging might create a bottleneck).

      Specified by:
      toString in interface TimeStampFormatter
      Parameters:
      timestamp - the epoch timestamp in milliseconds that is to be formatted into a string representation. It is interpreted based on the configured time zone and offsets.
      Returns:
      the string representation of the provided timestamp, formatted according to the internal configuration of this formatter.
      Throws:
      UncheckedIOException - if an I/O error occurs while constructing the formatted string.
